source.name: UN Comtrade via World Bank World Integrated Trade Solution (WITS)
source.description: Five leading reported merchandise export destinations by value; shares are percentages of each reporter’s total merchandise exports. Exports are FoB. These are export partners, not combined import/export partners, flight routes or transport paths.
source.selection: Prefer 2023; otherwise check 2022, then 2021, then WITS latest-available summary and retain its actual year. No gap filling, mirroring or estimates.
source.license: United Nations copyright; limited-table re-dissemination under UN Comtrade terms. Not CC BY.
source.precisionNote: WITS summary values are rounded to whole US$ millions; 0 can mean less than half a million. Shares retain the published two-decimal precision.
source.geographyNote: Partner ISO codes include territories outside the 195-country atlas. Null codes preserve unspecified, special and historical statistical categories. Do not draw an invented arc for them.
